E0610

`use alias.item` but alias is not a module (D-MOD3)

What

`use alias.item` but alias is not a module (D-MOD3)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0610

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0610: tests/ui/module_alias_not_module.stderr.

Error [E0610]: no module named `helper` in scope
  --> tests/ui/module_alias_not_module.jet:3:5
    |
  3 | use helper.something
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: the alias must refer to a module imported earlier in this file
 Fix: add `import … as helper`  before this `use`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0610

Error [E0102]: nothing named `something` exists here
  --> tests/ui/module_alias_not_module.jet:7:18
    |
  7 | fn run() { print(something()) }
    |                  ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: only functions that have been defined (or built in, like `print` / `input`) can be called
 Fix: define it first (fn something() { ... }), or call one that exists
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0102
